content: A simple pendulum has time period T<sub>1</sub>. The point of suspension is now moved upward according to the relation y = Kt<sup>2</sup>, (K = 1 m/s<sup>2</sup>) where y is the vertical displacement. The time period now become T<sub>2</sub>.
